name: leadline-match
brief: Rank the given candidate profiles (investors for a startup, or startups for an investor) for one subject profile, best fit first, top_k at most. A good match is a candidate likely to lead the subject's next round. Rank only the given candidates, by id. Each match has a score in [0, 1], score_parts, role (lead, participant or unknown), an activity status, a confidence and reasons that cite evidence ids. Put clear misfits in rejected with one of the listed reasons. Use only facts dated on or before request.as_of. Profile facts are dataset evidence; pages you read are web evidence with their url.

seed_tendencies.text: Rank candidates who have led rounds (role lead, high lead_share) above those who only joined rounds; a candidate seen only as a participant goes in rejected with reason follower_only when lead history is known.
Reject only on an observed fact: stage, sector, country or check size that clearly does not fit the subject. A missing or unknown field never rejects; rank it lower and say confidence low.
Prefer candidates with a lead in the 24 months before request.as_of; mark older activity as inactive. Ignore anything dated after request.as_of.
Every reason cites at least one evidence id from the evidence list; add each profile fact or web page you rely on to evidence once, with its ref or url.
Use only candidate ids from the input, each at most once across matches and rejected; never add the subject or new names.

settings_schema.description: Prefilter knobs (prefilter.py), applied before the agent ranks; the free gate checks them on cases.

rules.description: drop rules that are on (default: all four)

min_check_share.description: size rule: drop when the largest check is under this share of the round (default 0.05)

max_candidates.description: candidates passed to the agent after filtering (default 200)
